headline: Cross-Margin Contagion vs. Isolated Containment
subhead: Structural boundaries prevent asset shocks from cascading across portfolio collateral.

blocks.text: Cross-Margin Protocol: A single asset shock drains shared collateral pools, spreading liquidation risk portfolio-wide.
Isolated Architecture: Structural firewalls strictly seal settlement to the distressed position, preserving adjacent capital.

focal.reason: Demonstrates structural containment of liquidation risk to a single account without balance spillover.
